editorial.meta_description: The Here's to Your Health exam is retired. Candidates should prepare for the successor exam, Health & Human Development, offered by DSST for credit.
editorial.overview: The Here's to Your Health exam, certified by DSST, covered wellness, nutrition, fitness, mental health, disease, consumer health, and environmental health. This exam is now retired and has been replaced by the Health & Human Development exam. Candidates seeking certification in these health-related areas should focus their efforts on the current successor, which serves as the direct path forward for those pursuing this credential in the field of health studies. The transition ensures that all testing remains aligned with current academic standards and modern health science practices for all students.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam was intended for students and professionals seeking to demonstrate knowledge in health and wellness. As the exam is retired, individuals should now pursue the Health & Human Development exam to validate their expertise in these subject areas.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Focus your preparation on the Health & Human Development exam. Much of the content regarding wellness, nutrition, and fitness transfers from the retired exam. You must learn new material specific to the current curriculum requirements. Use official DSST resources to align your study plan with the successor exam's objectives. Do not prepare for the retired exam, as it is no longer available for testing. Ensure you review all updated materials to succeed in your academic goals.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the broad concepts of wellness and healthy living, focusing on the definitions of wellness and the implementation of healthy lifestyle habits that contribute to long-term physical and mental well-being for individuals.

This domain addresses the science of nutrition and dietary requirements, exploring the nutrient intake needed for human health and the application of established dietary guidelines to maintain optimal physiological function and prevent chronic illness.

This domain focuses on physical fitness and exercise science, emphasizing the importance of regular physical activity and the adherence to fitness standards that promote cardiovascular health, muscular strength, and overall physical endurance for diverse populations.

This domain examines mental health and psychological well-being, providing insights into mental health awareness and the practical application of stress management techniques to support emotional stability and cognitive health in various life situations and environments.

This domain covers the prevention and management of diseases, focusing on strategies for effective disease prevention and the assessment of health status to mitigate risks associated with communicable and non-communicable conditions throughout the human lifespan.

This domain addresses consumer health and informed decision-making, highlighting the importance of consumer health literacy and the evaluation of available health services to ensure safe and effective utilization of medical resources and products.

This domain explores the impact of the environment on health, analyzing how various environmental health factors influence public health outcomes and the collective efforts required to maintain safe living conditions for communities and the general population.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The retired exam cannot be scheduled. For the successor, Health & Human Development, ensure you arrive at the testing center with valid identification. The computer-based exam consists of 100 multiple-choice questions and allows 120 minutes for completion.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official exam consists of exactly 100 multiple-choice questions. Candidates should be prepared to answer all of these items within the allotted time frame to ensure they have the best opportunity to demonstrate their knowledge and achieve a passing result.

The required passing score for the exam is 400. This score represents the minimum level of proficiency needed to demonstrate sufficient understanding of the subject matter and to earn the associated credit for the health and human development course.

The total duration for the exam is 120 minutes. This time limit is designed to allow candidates to carefully read and respond to all questions, ensuring that they can complete the assessment within the standard testing period provided by the center.

faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam price is $85 for civilians. It is free for eligible military personnel via DANTES. This fee structure is standard for DSST exams, and candidates should verify their eligibility status before scheduling their testing appointment at an authorized center.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official DSST exam documentation and verified facts regarding the retirement of the HLTH exam and its successor, ensuring that all provided information is accurate and current for prospective test takers.

lifecycle.summary: DSST retired HLTH. Health & Human Development is the direct replacement path.
